turns.text: Can you talk in the past?
What often happens is students begin in the past— good— and then move into the present.
turns.zh: 经常出现的情况是，学生一开始用过去时——这很好——然后说着说着就跳到现在时了。

turns.text: Our teacher is very interesting." No!
It's such an easy mistake to make.
And the thing is to stay focused.
